description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 cinematic story prompt with attached video evidence from @nonameoasis.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3电影叙事提示词。

prompt: Cinematic 15-second sequence: A young athletic woman with short dark hair in a fitted dark spacesuit sprints desperately down a glass-walled spaceship corridor under flashing red emergency lights, stars visible outside. She bursts into a circular observation room and collapses against a massive round panoramic window, pressing her face and hands to the glass in exhaustion. Through the window a beautiful planet violently explodes — a massive wave of fire and energy races toward the ship and smashes into the glass in a blinding flash. Hard cut: the same woman jolts awake in a dark ordinary bedroom, gasping, covered in sweat. Handheld camera, urgent pacing, intense red emergency lighting, cinematic sci-fi destruction, realistic, film grain.
